themes.nameEn: negative experience without a specific reason

reviews.text: Best lists app!. I am amazed at all different features and choices! Best choice i made on a lists app!
One of the better apps.. I am enjoying life lists. It has a lot of capacity for

Best List Organizer By Far. Life Lists Organizer is the Swiss Army knife of apps. It is so flexible in terms of all it can do. It has replaced multiple apps I have been using. I just discovered DG Apps and all of their products are simple and superb. I wrote the developer a question and Dave got right back to me and was genuinely interested in my feedback. This is one of those apps Apple should put on every one of their devices. It’s that good.

A Difficult App. Not a good app for someone who is juggling multiple complex projects. Very difficult to organize tasks under each project and impossible to add notes for each task. Even worse, it was difficult to post this review
Great list. I’ve tried a lot of to do list apps, and so far, this one is my favorite. It’s easy to use, it keeps everything nice and organized. It keeps all of your lists in one place, and it’s free.
Not An Efficient App. Not easily sharable and freezes constantly.
Limited functionality. Wanted to sort a particular list by date. Also wanted to copy over a list into another app. Doesn’t give a copy/paste option for entire lists.

Love this app!!. I know that I’m going to LOVE this app. I get things done better if I have a list to go by. All the other apps have daily lists and you have to make one up every day. This one you can make a master list of all the things you do. Once you make the master list, just check them all done. Then each day you can just uncheck the ones you want to do and then check them off as you do them. No more forgetting things!!

I love it. I’ve been using this app ever since it was first made, in 2018, I’ve stopped using it for a few years, but i decided I wanted to use a to do and routine app again, so I came back to this app, and it still never fails to surprise me, I have autism so i absolutely love organizing stuff, lists, routines, schedules, shopping, etc, thank you so much for ever creating this app. 💛

Great app & support. I’ve been using this app for quite some time now and can honestly say it’s one of best of its kind available. And after I tested this latest update I have to admit I’ve been underutilizing this app for way too long. Onto custom lists and having fun too. 

From a recent small problem I was having with the previous version, I can also verify that Dave, the developer, provides excellent support. He not only fixed the problem quickly, he kept me informed the entire way. 
Great app! Excellent support!
What more do you need. 
Jim

Lost all lists suddenly. I had sync and backup on but today when i logged in all lists (4-5) and all individual items (over 500 ideas) were gone. I was using this to keep track of ideas big and small, book chapters and outlines, and more. Poof. Gone. The backup was still checked with a small disclaimer claiming an error occurred. I wouldn’t trust this app if I were you.
will not sync with icloud. no good

App is a mess. I really want to like this app. I've been using it for 2 to 3 years, but considering scrapping it and using Apple reminders instead. Every time an update comes out, I still see the same bugs. I've tried to contact the developer, but to no avail. He's either absent minded or has his email misconfigured. I'd be very happy to send screen shots of the bugs and tell him what's happening, but if don't get a response, I'm not going to waste my time. Just wish he'd get this app fixed.

This is an AMAZING APP!!. I love this organizer app! It has so many things on it and gives you an infinite amount of space to jot down anything you need! I did try to tap on one specific icon though and it completely went out of the app back to my Home Screen so I would fix that if it happens to everyone (the icon is the tilted paw print) but other than that this app seems great! You don’t need to pay any money either! ❤️❤️

My new go-to app. I was looking for a simple list making app without the bells and whistles or learning curve. At first I used it just for a basic to do list. I have found even more use with the handy ability to make multiple lists and love the template where you can rank the importance of each task. Better yet, the app doesn’t track you or ask for special permissions. Highly recommend.
Please fix this!!!. This app is ok. It works pretty well but when I click send a notification to remind me about things it doesn’t work at all.
Add support for apple watch!. Add support for apple watch so I can see my list created on another device there!

If using for important things, dont!. In every list you make, text will be consistently deleted. Also, I found the ability to only upload 3 photos for one notebook to be a slap to the face. The whole photo cannot be uploaded, parts will have to be cut out. Also when scrolling through text, it is not possible to see it all unless you are in edit mode.
WOW!!!. It is free and I enjoy it download it I recommend!!!!!!!!!!!😁😊😃

Organization made easier!. I really like this app as it helps me organize my life in an efficient amount of space. It’s easy to see & access your different “files”. Simplistic yet excellent at what it does. Thank you for creating & sharing!

New User. Started pretty recently using it. Really thought it was a pretty good. It seems to constantly ask you to rate it that was really annoying especially when in the midst of working on things. The last time it asked I was actually in it doing something and just clicked the X to close it. I figured as much ask they do I do it again at another time. Since I clicked the X I have not been able to get back into anything it just keeps closing every time I open it. Not happy. Need to find something else did so much work on there it is a shame. Thought I found a really good app. Too bad. It seems to be fixed. Thank goodness. I really do like this app. I find it very helpful. It is working fine now. Thank you, I really don’t mind responding to reviews periodically I I just was a little preoccupied at the moment and have memory issues so did not want to lose my train of thought. I really do like the app.

It worked for a little bit after my review now it won’t stay open again. It is really annoying do not know what is wrong with this app.

Great app with an annoying issue. I love this app, it's easy to use and very intuitive. However, PLEASE fix the issue where the last item on a list gets cut off!! Without that, it's a 5 star app.
EDIT: Thank you for fixing it!! This app is amazing, I would definitely recommend it.

The Best App For List Making!!!. I have tried so many list apps and note taking apps and none of them are anywhere near as good as this one! You can customize your list which is something the other apps I tried didn’t do! You get all of the features for free!! No in app purchases! In my opinion, this is the best app for an unorganized or organized person who also has ADHD!

Great App. Pros:
- NO ADS!
- Very customizable 
- Simple to use

Cons:
- Might be a bit convoluted for some

Overall I can recommend this app. Well done!!

Almost perfect. Almost the perfect app. There are some bugs I wish they could fix. The reminder for the habit list doesn’t work. The ability to create a new customizable “quick list” like the grocery list would be great - one that doesn’t change the global version of the list in app.

Not to Bad. This is a very good list app,one of the best I have found. I was able to make different list which your able to put in different formats. I think the app is well constructed and I would recommend to anyone. My only concern was recently all of my list disappeared. I reached out to the developer, who handled my request to fix promptly. I think the app still needs to have an option to back up your list on iCloud, but other than that I would definitely recommend. Thank you David for retrieving my list and all of your help.

Very Buggy!. With much excitement, I downloaded this app onto my iPhone this morning and started using it. Unfortunately, I am finding repeated behaviors where as I am doing some kind of action in the app it will all of a sudden close out and go back to the home screen of my phone. Somewhat ironically, when I click on report a bug, nothing happens! I really want to love this, but I don’t even know how to reach anyone to ask for help
How do you sync it?. Hi. Does this sync across Apple devices? I can’t figure out how.

Potential is there. I am recovering from a stroke and now have a mild cognitive impairment. I need help organizing schedules, appointments, and medications. This looks like it could be the one! However, when I first started setting up a list there were error messages that kept popping up. I logged out and went back in later. I could then make lists, but I keep getting an error when trying to set up notifications. My hope is this is a bug that will be fixed quickly. I will hold out for a couple of days before trying a different app.

Mrs. List. I’m a visual learner, so if I don’t have any to do things written down, then I don’t have any to do’s! I just jot down the basics of what needs to be done throughout the day and walk away from the list. If I have seen it then I’ll have replay and then abracadabra🎩🧺🪠🛒

Lost All My Lists…. Here is an update to a previous review I put out here. My previous review was that I had to reset my phone and when I got it up and running again all my list were gone. I sent an email and it took over a month to get a response which didn’t make me happy but the response is that since I had to reset my iPhone and this app does not utilize backing up to the cloud you lose everything. So word to the wise if you have to reset your phone, please take note of all your lists and you’ll have when you have to re-create everything. I had about five or six that I keep ongoing for stores that I go to and everything was wiped out. As a resolve, I am going to delete the app and I am going to use the REMINDER app (for lists) on the iPhone which now has lists and it’s very good. It just came out with I believe iOS 17 and if you need to know how to use it go to the internet or go to YouTube.
Not a fan. Lists do not stay in order, and app crashes when I try to rearrange. Sticking with your do lists app

Fantastic app and great developers. I’ve used this app for quite a while. I decided it was the easiest to use and most helpful for me. A couple of upgrades ago, it started having a wierd bug. It didn’t make the app unusable, but it was definitely less enjoyable to use. I reported the bug, they contacted me for details the very next day, and it was fixed within a couple of days. Fantastic response! Now I love it again! 😁♥️
Thank you for the update. Certain lists were crashing, but with the recent update everything is working again, so thank you. 5 stars

Nice App. I really like this app and use it nearly every day. I make a weekly to do list and I update it as I go. I make grocery lists, I have an ongoing gift ideas list, ideas list. My only complaint is that it doesn’t have an option to sync up to my calendar. I’d love to save some of my lists so I can see what all I got done on a particular day.
It’s great!. This is exactly what I was looking for in a todo list application.

Love the app but….. I’m loving the app so far, but I really need recurring reminders. I’m not sure if I’m just missing it, but if it’s not there I’ll sadly have to choose another app. Hope this can be resolved.

Great app.. BUT. This app is great - ALMOST. When listing tasks under the list - it automatically shifts them around - so then when you go to manually move them - they shift around even more out of order! PLEASE fix this! Or let me know if I’m doing something wrong?! Why do they keep moving around 😭

Frustrated. Used this for years but HATE recent update!! When trying to make a list, won’t stay in the order 
I need. When I add something (manually), the order changes and moves items. Used to be able to add items and put them in the order I want!!! Will have to look for new app!
One of my favorite apps. LOVE this app! Makes organization fun, I like the colors and icon options. I use this app just about every day.
Can’t paste after update. After most recent update, can’t paste any copied text in any tasks or notes. Interface updates are nice but need to have this basic feature available again!
keeps crashing. i love the different features it has compared to other list making/writing apps. this is what i've been looking for! the only problem is that it keeps crashing. 😔
Has its issues…. I would like to be able to have all 31 days of the month :) (for months that do apply to this)
I have a suggestion. You should really make a countdown type that would make this app perfect

I am having issues.. I was trying to use a movie icons and it crashed the app multiple times. And even trying to create a new list made it crash. On top of that I can’t report this bug. Since the report bug button wasn’t working.
Needs Sharing across Devices. Would be great to have sharing across devices, and/or with family
Bugs. This app is an immense help in staying organize, however, the app will randomly close itself.

The app I’ve been looking for. I have ADHD and sometimes the lists of information in my head feel chaotic. I’ve tried different apps and organizational systems before and nothing has seemed to stick. This is exactly what I’ve been looking for - I really wanted something that could group lists by category. it’s easy to use and I like the simple, streamlined aesthetic. I also love the option for different types of lists for different purposes. After a lot of searching, I’m glad I found this
amazing. if you like to be organized and have everything looking nice, neat & colorful! i highly suggest this app!

Amazing app. I was looking to plan a vacation and i realized that this app can help me do even more. I can use this app for grocery lists, to do lists, take notes, and write journals. There is much more that this app offers. The app lets you customize all the lists and make separate sections for each main idea. 

Definitely recommend this app to everyone looking for an easy way to keep things organized
Nice custom options but it keeps crashing. Nice custom options but it keeps crashing
I love the app BUT. I love the app so much but I wish there was an option to create an account so I can save the lists I made and access them on a different device.

PLEASE PLEASE PRETTY PLEASE… :). PLEASE make LifeLists a UNIVERSAL app (or create a separate iPad version) that also works in Landscape mode so that iPad users can take advantage of it! 

It really is a fantastic, ultra-intuitive app but it needs to come into the tablet/landscape world. 

It *otherwise* deserves 5 stars, but because I can’t use it for most purposes, I’ve knocked it down to 3. I’ll gladly revise it upward if you make a version we ALL can enjoy! Thanks for listening.

Really Handy. I was looking for a simple app to create lists, and this is it. Not only is it simple, but it’s also versatile - allowing easy customization for different categories of lists. If you have a list of repetitive tasks that you work on periodically you can check them off when you’re finished them, or tick a subset you want to do this time around, and then uncheck them when you’re done so the list is ready the next time you’re going to tackle that list. This app has earned a prized place on the bottom fixed set of apps on my phone.

Exportable / shareable lists?. It’s great that you can send everything out as a text list but could you add a way to import a list? Like by marking item notes with a special character that will import them as notes? Like this? Grocery List 🌟Eggs - make sure they are fresh ✨Regular item
Disappearing List. So I was in the middle of writing a long list and it glitched and deleted everything. I almost threw my phone!!! 🤬🤬🤬
ALMOST perfect. Add an iPad version and a widget and it will be 5 stars

Perfect?. I can’t think of anything this list maker doesn’t do. I return to comment on this app. and the Weekly Planner app. often. It’s the least I can do to support this developer. These apps. are amazing!

FANTASTIC!!!!!!. This app is amazing! I can finally capture random thoughts and To Dos in an organized system that I can take action on later. Helps keep my mind clear of clutter so I can focus on the task at hand.

Finally! A perfect list app!. My favorite list app just stopped updating and since iOS 11, it’s become glaringly obvious that I’d have to switch, but despite trying out virtually every list app across the App Store, I’d never found a simple app that got the job done.

Until now! I LOVE this app. I don’t write reviews often, but Life Lists gives me everything that Errands used to do, but soooo much more! No flash, no unnecessary accounts that link across 12 places with ten extra privacy policies. Just lists for what you need.

Need a checklist for what you want to do today? Done. Need a list for packing for a trip. Done. Keeping a list of books you’d like to read, shows to watch, games to play? Done, done, done! Life lists is simple and perfect like Errands used to be. Seriously, I was about to sit down and learn Swift myself to just make the app that I needed since I couldn’t find what I’d wanted until I came across Life Lists.

Again, I don’t write reviews often, but was so geeked about how great this app works for me that I was moved to say something. If you’re looking for a simple, clean listing app, I can’t recommend Life Lists more.

Fantastic For List Makers!. I’m not one to write reviews but as an avid keeper of lists, this app has blown my mind. Most other apps are so complicated they’re virtually useless to me, but this one does exactly what I want it to do, keep track of all my lists and give me lots of options to choose from for my obsessive list making. I even have a list of potential future lists! And it’s free? All I can say is THANK YOU!!!

Genius. Dear Mr. or Mrs. app maker- you are a genius. thank you so much for designing this app it is the closest thing I’ve ever found to how my brain works and to me what makes the most sense in organizing my day and working on time management skills . I’ve tried many apps and I’ve deleted many apps mainly because I didn’t understand them right away and got frustrated or because I just didn’t feel like using them because they weren’t fun and we’re stressful to use which is the whole point of trying to organize your time :to eliminate stress so I’ll not have a app that causes more! 
I have severe ADD and this app has helped me more than my medication It actually calms me to use this app it makes me feel in control of my time and of my life and the genius is in the simplicity....
Yet manages to be the only app I need for time management, notes and list, reminders,routines, habits, any area of self improvement really. 
Interestingly enough I did not download this app for any of those purposes. I set out to find an app to create lists in my head and I wanted to be able see them all like a board. I liked the way this one was laid out so I downloaded it. After using it for only 2 days I discovered that I could actually use this for many other things and eliminate many other apps on my phone that were only halfway useful
To people trying to decide if this is the app for them:
This is a safe simple ingenious application you will not be sorry that you downloaded, it will destress your life and illuminate the need for paper and pen altogether, I have thought of 1 million other things I’m going to use this app for and you will too ! The way my brain works and my personality, I have to have things in life that are not boring yet simple. I don’t like complicated things-I don’t like trying to hard- and I don’t like chaos, so if something doesn’t grab myInterest or makes sense to me right off the gate- I will delete it or toss it and move on - that goes for apps, people, relationships, new products, anything really. I don’t like wasting time or things that waste my time,I am impatient, and somewhat peculiar with my standards around certain things and I have a VERY short attention span. 
What I’m trying to say is if this app pleases me and does not annoy me, is 100% useful, is not in my opinion cluttered and something I consider smart and efficient-then I’m quite sure you will you like it very much. I DONT LIKE IT -I LOVE IT!!
Thanks for reading,
Rebecca M

FINALLY! A GREAT HABIT TRACKER & TO DO LISTS ALL EASY TO USE!!. Been searching like crazy. Who would’ve thought. 
INCREDIBLY THANKFUL for this app. 

Super easy to use. 
No monthly membership or need to pay for extra features. 
Habit tracker - ability to sort manually, add unlimited tasks, reminders. 
Different styles of lists and templates for you to choose from. 
Easy to create based on whatever need you may have. 
I needed one to build daily habits without the fuss. Other apps were seriously getting too complicated with their intricacies.

Hate the changes. I’ve used this app for years and loved it. Then it started putting items in categories I don’t want. For instance, it placed “baking soda” in a “beverages” category and “wine vinegar” in a “beer and wine” category. It thus scatters all my grocery items out into nonsensical categories that I have to go in and delete. Stupid, poorly thought-out and unnecessary change.
👍. Great app. I just wish the interface was more modern.

O M G. I have used all sorts of organizing apps but this is THE most perfect one I have ever used. When I saw it, a light flashed before my eyes and I knew I was in app heaven. Whoever developed this is a friggin’ genius!

Love your app. And I’ve been searching and trying so many. It’s simple (user friendly) if you’re PC literate. Great icons and colors that you can create to your liking. Love it! Wondering ......Is this available in Android? Friend who has an android phone might be interested. Actually, I know she will be 🙂 TY

so cute! one question though. i love how it’s all - in - one and super cute! i love organization. i have a question though. i can’t seem to get my apple watch to show the app! the app comes up on my watch, but when i open it it’s just a black screen and i can’t seem to figure out how to fix this. any help would be awesome! thanks :)
Not user friendly. I think I need to look for something else. This app is not user friendly. Lists should be simple just a list!

Beautifully Done!. It’s hard to find apps that look and do what this one does. So far I haven’t find one until now. Please don’t change anything in this app. I have a hard time seeing because of my age but this is perfect. It keeps my life organized while keeping it simple. Love it.
Not syncing to watch. Doesn’t sync to watch all that great. Specifically viewing the packing list on the watch app was the only reason I wanted to try this, bummed.

Would be a good little app. This app has everything in it that I have been looking for, the only disappointment I have is that every time I try to do my cleaning list the app crashes and closes out. It seems that is the only one that’s not working and it is the one I really wanted. But overall I like the app. If they can fix the part where it crashes during the cleaning section I probably give it a higher rating.

Contact Option Not Working. First off, a big thank you for this app! This is one useful app especially for people who love making list!

I tried clicking the Request a Feature and Report Bug under Settings > Contact but nothing happens. 

I just want to request a feature wherein you can adjust the text size. The current text size is large for my view. It would be great if text size can be adjusted. 

For the bug, well the Request Feature/Report Bug are not working. 

Thanks again for this app!

Just what I was looking for. I really like this app. Easy to use, love the color options, and all the different icons. Thank you! One question - is there a way to manually sort lists? I’m thinking about my grocery list. I like to brain dump, but then I would like to go back and manually move items around in order of my specific store.

Pain to view. Once a list is created and saved I can only see the first 5 items without going into edit mode. When in edit you can’t see
The whole list because of keyboard. Deleting...

1st Look 👀 & BEST REASON TO LOOK a 2nd TIME.... I found your app. I read the comments. I haven’t even downloaded it yet but I’m giving it/you 5 Stars. 
 1st THING I LOOKED AT is App HISTORY & UPDATES. You, the App Creator are ON TOP OF THIS APP! 
I see Dated Continual TWEAKS, personal ANSWERS to comments, HELP offered for problems, your INTENT to make improvements .... I think I’m gonna like your app... and if you stay with it, I’ll stay with you!

Handy & Useful. I’ve been told to make lists as a means of staying organized. This app has got me doing that. It lets you make multiple lists. I have a list for what I will do each day. I have one for books read and other books I want to read. I can add notes to entries. You can make bullet lists or just jot quick notes. Interface is clean and simple. I am surprised how many to do apps that I have tried are confusing and not intuitive. Life Lists serves me well.
All I need. It’s amazing app

Missing most important feature. This app is like freshly baked, not even fully done yet as of 04/08/2020. 

It’ll be much better if they add the most important feature: RECURRING to the app.

Great app! Just missing 1 thing.... Lots of options!! The only thing lacking is a search bar to quickly find something in a longer list. You can alphabetize but that’s a ridiculous amount of scrolling when there’s 100s of things on a list. Why not add an alphabet “jump to” bar or search bar?
Phenomenal. I have tried so many list apps, and I must say, this is the best one yet! Thank you so much!

Great App (updated review). I love the app. It’s exactly what I was looking for, however it does have some bugs like if you chose “add & add more” but then change you mind. You either have to close out the app completely (which starts a chain of force closures by the app) OR you have to type something in and then save it and go back in and delete it . There’s many little quirks about the app like that but otherwise, it really is great.

Update: I’m changing my rating to 5 stars ✨
The developer was quick to come up with a solution once aware of the problem!

& to the developer, you’re welcome! You really did make an awesome app & I would’ve kept using it, even with the bugs 😉

How does this not sync with my iphone?!. I really want to love this app...but it does not sync between my iPad and iphone so it’s pointless to put the time into organizing. It does not even show up in my list of apps under my settings (or in the cloud), which is really odd.

totally recommend!!. I just downloaded this app today and i absolutely love it! Very simple layout and i love the customizable features and lack of ads! Totally easy to use and keep track of things.

But,
There is a minor bug problem: When i press the + button to create a new custom list, I enter the title of the list and the app freezes. I deleted and reinstalled it a couple times, and restarted my device, and my internet is fine, so I'm pretty sure its a bug within the app. 

Aside from that, I absolutely love this app.

Cross platform and list sharing!. This is required for your app to be successful. Also see my feedback email I sent. This could be a great app. It has tons of potential to be another ListPro or Wunderlist app which are no more.

As I see further development and upgrades, I will change my review and rating accordingly. As a prior developer, I'm pretty hard on my reviews. I expect close perfection to get 5 stars. I ask that you keep this app a list maker and list share model. Follow the development progress of both of the apps listed and your app will be highly successful. 

Then don't sell it please...and maintain. A version release, even if a performance improvement, a few additional icons, user customizable features, additional colors, etc. every few weeks or every month will keep interest. Your user base will drop quick if users do not see a few simple changes often.

Developer responds quickly to bug reports. EDIT: The bug described below has been fixed! It’s a lovely little app that helps me to keep my head on straight while I’m doing tasks!

EDIT: I was having an issue which was described below in the original review. The developer responded quickly and a fix will be out soon. I will put down the full five once it’s fixed.

Aside from that, this app is pretty great! I have autism (which often comes with executive functioning troubles), and as such find it difficult sometimes, while in the middle of doing tasks, to remember all the steps and to execute the steps in the proper order. With this app, I can write every detail down before I start doing things so I don’t get confused, and that has been incredibly helpful. I can do things much more quickly now.

 I find it a little annoying to have to delete the sample items inside the pre-existing lists before doing anything with them, but that’s just a minor issue for me, I found this program to be intuitive to use without such assistance, but others might like seeing or need to see example usage to get an idea of how to make it work.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
Trying to access all the fancy content so maybe I can make a recipe list.

Well. I started with a moussaka recipe. So I tried to create a sectioned list, just like in the grocery list where they put items in sections like “Bread” or “Canned” or whatever. The sections work fine in the grocery list, as expected. So I figured if I tried making my own sectioned list, then it would work like the grocery list.

But it doesn’t. For every single item that I try to add under the Moussaka section, it adds ANOTHER SECTION CALLED MOUSSAKA. And so now my list has 19 sections with one ingredient instead of one section with 19 ingredients underneath. The things don’t collapse into one section.

Needless to say, I am rather upset that I wasted money on a thing that doesn’t even fully work.

EDIT:
I got it to work like expected. However, in order for it to work, after you make the custom list, you have to close the app and re-open it before you add anything to it so that it doesn’t make 19 different sections all called moussaka for each ingredient. If you want the sectioned list to work and properly add stuff to sections, you have to close it and reopen it before adding anything to a custom list.

Please fix this, or at least make it clear that you gotta restart the program before custom lists will work properly.

Finally a good app to help me stay organized. I have tried lots of apps and none helped but after I found this app my life became more organized then ever and I get lots of things done because of this app I just love this app.

Amazing!. I never write reviews, but this app is amazing. It’s really a to do list, a note pad, a planner and a habit tracker in one. It has a very clean look and it is very easy to input entries. It replaced 4-5 different apps for me and I love having everything easily accessible and in one place.

Add recurring reminders/to-dos option please!. I love this app so far. This is exactly what I needed. I'm sick of having to use several different apps for each individual thing. I write down so many notes, ideas, lyrics, to-do's, reminders, etc. I NEED to have them in one place. Why aren't there more apps like this? It's also very aesthetically pleasing. 
One thing I'm sad about though is that you can't set reminders or any item in a list to be recurring. A couple of other things as well: I would like more options for sorting lists other than alphabetical and manual. It would be nice to be able to choose if a new item appears at the top or bottom of a list. Also something that I would really like is having a timestamp on notes for when you made them. Maybe it could even be an option you could turn on or off? Otherwise great work guys. Appreciate ya
